file_id: M-S Jyoti Industries vs The State Of Chhattisgarh on 26 July, 2021

sentences.text: M/S Jyoti Industries vs The State Of Chhattisgarh

on 26 July,
2021
 High Court Of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur
 Order Sheet
 Wpc No. 2855 of 2021
 M/s. Jyoti Industries -Versus- The State of Chhattisgarh & Anr.
26.07.2021
Mr. D.K.Gwalre, Advocate for the Petitioner.
Mr. Siddharth Dubey, Dy. Govt. Advocate for the State.

Heard Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that grant of prosecution under Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 is bad in law, as the product was found within norms but misbranded and the sanction order also do not contain that there is an application of mind.
State counsel prays time to file reply.
Let the reply of the State be filed.
Considering the issue involved, it needs adjudication.
In the meanwhile, the proceeding may go on pursuant to the show cause notice, however, final orders may not be drawn.

Sd/-
 Li (Goutam Bhaduri)
 Judge  Ashok M/S Jyoti Industries vs The State Of Chhattisgarh on 26 July, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39974748/
